product-rule-area.alt: A rectangle with width f and height g has area f times g. When x changes a little, the width grows by delta f and the height by delta g. The new area adds a strip g delta f on the right, a strip f delta g along the bottom, and a tiny corner delta f delta g. Dividing by delta x and letting delta x go to 0 makes the corner vanish, which gives (fg) prime = f prime g + f g prime.
